author: enumeration_review
scientific_review: Accepted both bounded lemmas. I independently traced all displayed literal head edges for G0,G1,G2 and their shared labels. The G3 product has exactly two orbits precisely when its actual suffix is transitive; no natural-suffix inference is made. For G4, the seven-point core, the K-orbit of x fixed by delta and a moved delta point are three distinct actual omission orbits; transitivity then needs at least two eligible edges. The pure-overlap/IP proof supplies delta fixing x without assuming B-transitivity.
